statements.t: Subject to the terms and conditions of the Merger Agreement, at the effective time of the Merger, each share of the Company's common stock issued and outstanding will be converted into the right to receive 0.086 of a share of HomeTrust common stock, plus cash in lieu of any fractional shares.

Based on the number of shares of the Company's common stock outstanding and reserved for issuance and the number of shares underlying Warrants subject to warrant conversion agreements, HomeTrust expects to issue approximately 8,314,956 shares of HomeTrust common stock to the Company's shareholders in the Merger.

Following completion of the Merger, former shareholders of the Company are expected to own approximately 35% of HomeTrust's outstanding common stock, with existing HomeTrust stockholders owning approximately 65%.
